rules: Q1 route overlay, convergence and Pareto figures must share route_id/optimizer_id and final feasibility/objective registry; paper label alone is insufficient.
Q1 if code evidence lacks GA/Pareto primitives, do not let a GA-looking convergence figure upgrade implementation confidence.
Q2 maps/radars/rankings require deterministic source features; stochastic placeholders must be separately marked synthetic and excluded from real-result panels.
Q2 validation figure must be regenerated from raw expert/measurement predictions and one metric registry; hard-coded score dictionaries are not evidence.
Q3 t-SNE/PCA/similarity heatmaps are descriptive; validate on unseen garden entities or predeclared pair labels.
Q3 similarity diagonal is an identity check only; it cannot be listed as external model-validity evidence.
Any learning curve/CV plot must state independent sample unit and entity grouping before pair augmentation.
Code appendix figures/pages are evidence for static method-to-primitive coverage, not runtime reproduction.
